svg.title: Keyring Enterprise Solution Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end Azure solution architecture for Keyring showing users, Microsoft Entra ID OIDC and OBO authentication, stateless Keyring runtime on App Service or Container Apps with a single managed identity, multi-environment Azure Key Vaults (dev, test, prod) over Private Endpoints, and audit, Microsoft Sentinel, Event Grid and Azure Communication Services integrations.
svg.text: Stateless Rust PAM front end for Azure Key Vault · Multi-environment governance (Dev / Test / Prod) · Zero stored credentials
Authentication, Conditional Access, Delegated OBO & PIM
Single 8 MB Rust container (Axum + Askama, forbid(unsafe_code), zero npm)
• Pre-Azure guards: Origin check, vault-bound CSRF, typed delete name, purge off
• Governance gates: Step-up acrs, Reason/Ticket, Password policy, Owner, Reveal limit
• Multi-Env Matrix & Writer: Value-blind dev/test/prod parity & duplicate guard
• In-memory sessions: Per-user OBO cache & 60s metadata cache (zero shared state)
Keyring's managed identity holds zero roles on any customer Key Vault.
Customer Azure Subscriptions (Called as Signed-In User)
Every read & write uses the person's OBO token · Key Vault RBAC decides
Dual audit trail (Key Vault + KeyringAudit_CL), Sentinel & ACS Email
Health, expiry, access request, watched-read, destructive & share notices
Sent via Managed ID only · domain allow-list, rate limits & zero secrets
User OBO Token (Key Vaults, ARM, Graph, Audit Reads)
Managed Identity (Federated Cred, Audit Sink, ACS Email)
